resources.string: On the computer running Ducter, run ducter pair, then scan the QR code it shows.
ducter.example.com, or paste the whole link
The code works once. After that this phone remembers the connection; disconnect it anytime with ducter devices on that computer.

This copy of Ducter was installed from somewhere else, so Android won\'t update it from the release. Uninstall it and install the APK from the release once.
Ducter on %1$s is still %2$s, older than this app; some new things wait for it to update.
Ducter on %1$s is older than this app; some new things wait for it to update.
Lets a Ducter task use this phone\'s apps, only while you lend it one

When a task asks to use this phone and you say yes, Ducter reads the screen of the app in front and taps, swipes and types for it. A pill at the top shows it\'s happening, with Stop. Anything that sends, pays or deletes waits for your Go; banking, wallet, password and authenticator apps stay out of reach, and password fields are never read or typed. Off between tasks: it reads nothing until you lend it the phone.
When you\'re done, tap Done on the card
Stop the task using this phone

When you lent this phone while it was locked, and after you unlock a loan that paused.
You said Lend it. Unlock this phone and it starts, shown at the top the whole time.

You locked this phone, so it does nothing. After you unlock, you choose whether it carries on.
It paused when you locked the phone. Keep lending, and it carries on where it was; Not now, and the phone is yours again.
